Gabe L.: opened a tiny PR to clarify dashboard filter examples and tweak observability microcopy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5301 :wave:
Yuna M.: skimmed. can we make the filter examples explicitly show snake_case `trace_id` and include an example using `trace_id IN (...)` for bulk view? helps PMs.
Priya S.: good call. I'll add an example table showing single vs bulk filters and a sentence under the cost table: "Average sequence length affects batching efficiency and therefore per-token billing." Keep non-technical.
Yuna M.: also swap the kv snippet from manual key concat to helper call so users don't copy internal prefixes:
```js
// before
await kv.set(`sess:${sessionId}:kv`, obj)
// after
await kv.setForSession(sessionId, obj)
```
link-bot: found one dead link to /console/observability/old-guide -> replaced with /console/observability. 1 replacement.
Gabe L.: pushed edits, CI passed. final: squash lint commit then merge. anyone object?
Yuna M.: no objections. Priya S.: none, merging later today. #product-docs :sparkles:
__notes: short thread for docs PR: dashboard filter examples, kv helper swap, cost note, link replacement, CI pass
